answer: Linear-refund entry bond: a new wallet locks 40 POA and gets 2 POA back each epoch, but only for epochs in which it answers the challenge. Honest Walnut answers daily and recovers everything in 20 epochs, while 1,000 fakes must lock 40,000 POA. An attacker such as Zephyr could recycle one bond through a second wallet called Velvet, yet the refund goes only to the original funder after 20 epochs, so one bond backs one wallet. Jurors sample 5% of wallets against public funding links, and a shared funder forfeits the unrefunded half.
